test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 15 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.**

Harry said, "My son is in danger and I need help."

options.text: Harry said his son was in danger and I needed help.
His son said that Harry was in danger and that he needed help.
Harry said his son is in danger and I need help.
Harry said that his son was in danger and he needed help.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Harry said that his son was in danger and he needed help.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The given sentence is a direct speech and we need to convert it into an indirect speech.
 
• We follow these rules in Direct-Indirect speech:
 
 
• The reporting verb 'said' remains the same in the indirect speech part.
 
• The pronoun 'my' changes to 'his' in the indirect speech.
 
• The helping verb 'is' in the direct speech changes to 'was' in the indirect speech.
 
• The inverted commas ("...") are replaced with the preposition 'that' to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The comma (,) is omitted to show the indirect speech part.
 
• The first word of the indirect speech is in capital letters.
 
• "**I**" in the direct speech changes to "**him**" in the indirect speech.
 
• The 1st form of the verb "**need**" changes to the third form "**needed**" in indirect speech.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

The indirect sentence is: *Harry said that his son was in danger and he needed help.*
